notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE269882, right atrial appendage bulk RNA-seq, Illumina HiSeq 2500, 27 libraries. VERIFIED DESIGN: the series matrix gives sinus rhythm 9, post-operative AF 8, paroxysmal AF 5, persistent AF 5 (the pre-existing audit recorded SR 10 / poAF 7; the deposit says 9 / 8 and this item follows the deposit). The count matrix columns are patient numbers in a different order from the series; the join is by patient number and is verified with the XIST/RPS4Y1/DDX3Y/UTY/KDM5D sex probes (26 of 27 labels agree; the annotated-female patient 1409 has a male expression profile, recorded not corrected). TIER: admitted only as tier 3 (whole-tissue bulk) under ADR 0071, which supersedes the ADR 0070 whole-tissue exclusion; this is NOT GSE271229 (a separate left-atrial snRNA series with no author cell-type annotation, audited and rejected). MEASURED v2 DEGs: 0 in all three declared staged contrasts (minimum padj 0.972 / 0.998 / 0.99997) and 0 in the pooled-AF sensitivity; the honest zero is published. The deposited TPM matrix is fetched as a cross-check (Spearman 0.90-0.93 against the count-model effects) but the DEG input is the raw counts. BUILD: capped 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS 272 MB, wall 8.8 s. REPRODUCTION: script/fetch.sh -> script/verify.sh -> script/build_deg.py; a second build is byte-identical.
purpose: Human right-atrial-appendage whole-tissue bulk RNA-seq source for the Stage 2 gene axis under ADR 0071: the three staged AF arms vs sinus rhythm. Tier-3 AF source (whole-tissue bulk, not cardiomyocyte-specific); the measured v2 DEG count is zero.
